notes: Receipts live at households/<household_id>/transactions/<transaction_id>/<file>, and carry the household as an object attribute so the rules can read it.

The attribute names the household; the claim decides. Attaching a household the caller is not a member of matches no claim and grants nothing, which is the same shape as a document carrying a household_id the policy checks against the caller's claims.
Findings log #8: before object attributes the rule could only reach the uploader, so a receipt was invisible to the rest of the household.
